title: Ignored late callback telemetry
why: If missing-row callback mutations become safe no-ops, operators still need to know that cleanup races happened and how often.

title: Reset drain completion signal
why: The control plane needs an explicit condition that destructive deletion is safe, rather than inferring it indirectly from queue or snapshot state.

title: Autonomy gate summary surface
why: The agent currently assembles relaunch readiness from multiple separate surfaces instead of reading one explicit gate result.
